periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented at approximately a 45-degree angle downward and outward from the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering observed, with the lowest point of the patch extending significantly below the horizontal midline of the eye.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The gap between the medial edges of the ears is approximately 1.2 times the width of a single ear unit.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded, semicircular convex curvature at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive occlusion of the thoracic region by bamboo foliage; pronounced yellowish hue on the ventral fur compared to the cranial fur.
